title: Rapid coverage census — shadow capacity & owners
body:
Purpose:
Quick, lightweight census of "shadow" (standby / canary / burst) capacity by region and owner. Goal: give oncall / rotations a one-page view for fallback decisions during regional incidents and to identify single-owner gaps. Not a canonical source of truth — pull from infra dashboards and owners listed below when we decide to act.

How to use:
- Triage: use summary + owners column to call fallback.
- Operations: owners confirm or update numbers within 48h.
- Product/SE: use action items to request additional reserved capacity if repeated gaps.

SUMMARY (top-line):
- Total known shadow GPUs: 126 across regions (estimate).
- Big gaps: EU-west staging pool not tagged for dedicated fallbacks, APAC burst quota low for critical-beam models.
- Immediate ask: owners to confirm numbers or flag inaccuracies by 2027-11-10.

REGION ROWS (human-readable table):
Columns: Region | Service / pool name | Shadow GPUs (est) | Typical peak tokens / min | SLA tier (prod/canary/dev) | Primary owner | Notes / gap | Immediate action

1) us-west | dedicated-shadow-pool-1 | 40 | ~1.2k tpm | prod-canary | Ethan R. | active but not reachable from eu-regional-fallback | Confirm subnet peering + update route table (Ethan)
2) us-east | burst-pool-s-2 | 28 | ~900 tpm | prod | Priya S. | CPU-limited for <8k seq workloads | Schedule small-scale warm instance (Priya)
3) eu-west | staging-shadow-v2 | 12 | ~450 tpm | dev/canary | Unassigned | not tagged, sitting under staging project-A | Owner needed — propose Liam O'C to temp own
4) eu-central | fallback-cache-1 | 8 | ~300 tpm | canary | Maya P. | under KMS restrictions for private deploys | Confirm KMS access path for fallback (Maya)
5) ap-southeast | auto-burst-asia | 18 | ~600 tpm | prod-canary | Ramesh N. | quota=soft-limit; strong risk during promo spikes | Request burst quota increase (Ramesh)
6) ap-northeast | reserve-shadow-1 | 20 | ~700 tpm | canary | Priya S. | infra team notes: on rolling upgrade next week | Mark as unavailable 2027-11-12 to 2027-11-14
7) sa-east | tiny-fallback | 0 | 0 | dev | N/A | no shadow capacity — low traffic region | Consider no action unless customer demand appears

ASSUMPTIONS & DATA SOURCES:
- Numbers taken from quick calls to infra-cost and the per-region node list (naively counted). Treat as +/- 10–20%.
- "Shadow GPUs" here means non-primary reserved capacity that can be used for emergency fallbacks or canary routing. Excludes ephemeral preemptibles that have <30 min uptime historically.
- Latency/throughput estimates are rough and used only for triage decisions.

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS:
- Who will own eu-west staging pool? (ACTION: propose temp owner by 2027-11-10)
- Are KMS policies for private deploys in eu-central blocking cross-region fallback? (ACTION: Maya to escalate to security)
- APAC quota increases need a billing approval — how quickly can finance sign off? (ACTION: Ramesh to open ticket and tag @finance-ops)

ACTIONS (short list):
- Ethan: validate us-west route table and confirm reachable endpoints (due 2027-11-06).
- Priya: open infra ticket to warm an extra instance in us-east burst pool (due 2027-11-09).
- Liam: volunteer to temporarily own eu-west staging or nominate someone (due 2027-11-10).
- Ramesh: start quota request for ap-southeast (link ticket RDW-4999) and CC finance (due 2027-11-12).
- Maya: check KMS cross-region policy and list blocked key(s) (due 2027-11-09).

NOTES TO SELF / QUICK IDEAS (raw):
- Could add a tiny status color column (green/amber/red) for at-a-glance during incident calls.
- Short-term hack: maintain a single slack message pinned in #eng-coverage with the top 3 fallbacks by region. Easier than hunting the sheet in outages.
- Longer-term: feed this into a tiny dashboard in the Console for automatic detection of owner-less pools.

HISTORY / CHANGES TRACKED HERE:
- 2027-11-03: created initial census (Maya).
- 2027-11-05: Priya added us-east warm instance note.
- 2027-11-08: Ethan updated us-west reachability note.

CONTACTS / OWNER DIRECTORY (quick):
- Ethan Ramirez — eng-platform-engineering — ethan@redwood.ai — primary on us-west
- Priya Shah — infra — priya@redwood.ai — primary on us-east + ap-northeast
- Liam O'Connor — solutions engineering — liam@redwood.ai — suggested eu-west temp owner
- Ramesh Nair — regional infra APAC — ramesh@redwood.ai — ap-southeast

If you see anything off, annotate inline and I'll reconcile. This is intentionally lightweight — we want something we can read quickly on-call and not a canonical inventory.

--- end of sheet ---
notes_summary: Lightweight region-by-region census of standby GPU capacity for fallback routing; owners must confirm or update by 2027-11-10; immediate actions assigned to Ethan, Priya, Liam, Ramesh, and Maya.
